data.name: Catharina
data.gender_notes: Catharina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'katharos', meaning 'pure' or 'clean'. In the New Testament, Saint Catherine of Alexandria was a renowned Christian martyr, adding to the spiritual significance of this name. The name Catharina carries the meaning “Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Catharina usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Catharina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Catharina total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: קתרינה
in_hebrew.meaning: טהורה וזכה במשמעות הקרובה לטוהר ולזכות
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קתרינה נגזר מהמילה היוונית קתרוס, שפירושה טוהר. הוא קשור למושגים של טהירות וזכות, ומשמש לעיתים קרובות כסמל לטוהר הלב והנפש. השם הופיע לראשונה בתקופה היוונית והפך פופולרי בקרב הנוצרים בשל קשריו לטוהר ולצדק.

in_greek.name: Καταρίνα
in_greek.meaning: Καθαρή και αγνή, καθαρότητα και αθωότητα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καταρίνα προέρχεται από το ελληνικό καθαρός (katharos), που σημαίνει καθαρότητα. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοιες λέξεις σχετίζονται με την πνευματική καθαρότητα. Η Καταρίνα έγινε δημοφιλές όνομα μεταξύ των Χριστιανών λόγω της συσχέτισής του με την αθωότητα και την πνευματική ανανέωση.

in_latin.name: Catharina
in_latin.meaning: Pura et immaculata, munditia et innocentia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Catharina derivatum est ex voce Graeca katharos, quae puritatem significat. In primitiva Ecclesia Christiana, hoc nomen habitum est symbolum munditiae cordis et spiritus. Catharina, ut nomen femininum, late diffusum est propter associationem suam cum castitate et virtute.

in_english.name: Catharina

The name is often linked with Saint Catherine, a revered figure in Christian tradition known for her wisdom, courage, and martyrdom.
